pair_skew:eth.function: Link is not affected at tens of mm (about 2 % of an 8 ns symbol at 25 mm; adaptive equalisation). Hard limit is vendor layout guidance, EMC-driven (mode conversion).

sources.quote: lengths of the differential traces (within each pair) should be equal to within 50 mils (1.25 mm)
length-matched within 20 mils for 1G, 50 mils for 100M/10M

pair_skew:eth.notes: target = CM5 datasheet 'ideally'; hard = Pulse 50 mil (magnetics vendor of the part used); TI 20 mil (0.51 mm) is the tightest PHY-vendor figure. reports/ETH skew limits line vs PHY side.md

pair_skew:usb2.function: USB-IF gives no PCB skew number (cable only, 100 ps). Vendor MAX 50-60 mil.

pair_skew:usb2.notes: judge per signal path on USB-C joined rows (stub <= 3.5 mm, USB Type-C R2.0 Table 3-4)
